newsitem.title: UK: TBI buys rest of Fairmark from Adelaide.
newsitem.headline: TBI buys rest of Fairmark from Adelaide.

text.p: Property company TBI Plc on Tuesday said it is to buy the rest of Fairmark Industries Plc that it does not already own from Adelaide Steamship (U.K.) Ltd.
TBI will pay for the deal with 1.5 million new ordinary shares at 90 pence a share and may have to make an additional cash payment up to a maximum of three million pounds.

Fairmark is a property company whose main asset is the Fountains Office Park in Brentford Middlesex in south east England. This has 115,000 square feet of office space in three buildings let to SmithKline Beecham Plc.

Fairmark made a loss of 234,000 pounds in the year to March 31 1996 after provision for a reduction in the property's value. Its net assets were 3.68 million pounds, discounting inter-company indebtedness.
